metadata.description: Baseline metrics and expectations for downstream joins and lookups before/after PII transformation
metadata.author: Nguyen Trung Kien (Data Engineer, Team P-138)

postgres_join.query: SELECT o.order_id, o.customer_cccd, c.cccd FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_cccd = c.cccd
postgres_join.description: Join orders ⨝ customers via CCCD (HMAC join key preservation)

baseline.note: All orders have customer_cccd; join count must remain identical after consistent HMAC transformation

postgres_aggregate.query: SELECT c.customer_id, SUM(od.unit_price * od.quantity * (1 - od.discount)) AS total_revenue FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_cccd = c.cccd JOIN order_details od ON o.order_id = od.order_id GROUP BY c.customer_id
postgres_aggregate.description: Customer revenue aggregation across 3 tables joined via CCCD

baseline.note: After HMAC masking of CCCD, aggregate group counts and revenue sum must remain unchanged

mongo_lookup_cccd.description: $lookup orders -> customers via CCCD (pii_ext.customer_cccd <-> identity.cccd, HMAC join key)

baseline.note: After HMAC transformation of CCCD in both collections, matched document count must match baseline
